purpose: Untouched territorial holdout for scoring Models B/C and, only after those benchmarks are frozen, bounded Model D. These constituencies must not be used for parameter tuning.
selection_rule: Geographically diverse local constituencies whose 2021 detailed result pages had not been opened or queried during the current evidence-building run at freeze time. Rabat-Sale-Kenitra is omitted because its local pages had already been batch-opened.
rules: Do not use holdout 2021 outcomes to fit synthetic-population, diffusion, portability, turnout or party-choice parameters.
Freeze B and C predictions/scores before any Model D prompt or model tuning against this holdout.
After unsealing, retain exact source provenance and the pre-unseal commit hash.
Any accidental exposure must be recorded and the affected constituency replaced before scoring.
